decisions.reason: Having been kept through 2024 and still publicly presented on its own page, escalation pressures from prior investment and the need to justify the earlier keep decision make withdrawal unlikely.
As a recently launched product building on the established offer with its own page, early disappointing results can still be attributed to temporary causes, so escalation favors persistence.
Although its distance from the established offer lowers centrality, the product's own page and sunk launch costs create enough escalation pressure to keep it unless results are severely negative.
Similar to D but slightly more distant and specialized, its public commitment and launch investments still make withdrawal less likely than retention under escalation, albeit with a higher risk.
As a flagship product line closely aligned with the announced direction and highly visible, escalation of commitment strongly favors continuing despite any early difficulties.
